_comment: SAMPLE config for the H-HOOKS modules (commit-block, atomic-tracking, clickup-gate). This file is DATA, not mechanism -- hooks.py hardcodes none of these values. An engagement supplies its own. The values below are GENERIC illustrations (no engagement-specific board filenames, ClickUp space IDs, or repo branch policy baked into code); safe to adapt per engagement and to promote to TbAIOS.

atomic_tracking._note: Each engagement declares its OWN tracking file(s). E.g. a repo might set docs/tracking.md; another engagement might use a different board. Never assume a specific filename.

clickup_gate._note: DEFAULT-DENY: only these read verbs pass; every other verb, and any op whose verb/target cannot be determined, is blocked. `targets` lets the module self-identify ClickUp calls from a generic payload.calls list when the adapter has not pre-extracted payload.clickup_ops.
